price.quote: Vika X Folding eBike | $1,799.00 | Product information

cls.quote: The Vika X is a class 2 ebike that can be changed to a class 3 ebike with the Blix app, increasing the pedal assist top speed from 20 mph to 28 mph.
The Vika X ships as a Class 2 e-bike set to 20 mph, but it can be unlocked to a Class 3 with pedal assist up to 28 mph through the Blix Connect app.
